categories.name: Coding
categories.description: Recommended combinations for daily development, technical research, frontend polish, and complex engineering work.

combos.title: Coding Research Stack
combos.summary: A practical stack for coding tasks that need fresh web research, current official docs, and polished frontend delivery.
combos.audience: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and other agent CLI users

components.name: Firecrawl
components.description: Web search and crawling for collecting the latest technical context, product notes, and API changes before implementation.
components.why: Useful for fast-moving APIs, product announcements, migration guides, and third-party references.
notes: The setup command opens a browser for authorization.
After authorization, Firecrawl capabilities become available in the agent skill manager.

components.name: Context7
components.description: Documentation lookup for current official framework, SDK, and library guidance.
components.why: Helps confirm modern usage for React, Next.js, Tailwind, Prisma, OpenAI SDK, and other dependencies before coding.
notes: Authorization avoids manual API key entry.

components.name: UI UX Pro Max
components.install:
npm install -g uipro-cli
uipro init --ai codex # Codex CLI
components.description: Frontend experience and visual quality skill pack for turning working screens into stronger product interfaces.
components.why: Helps reduce template-like layouts, random card piles, overused emoji, and flat color systems.
notes: Best used during the final UI implementation and interaction review pass.

workflow: Use Firecrawl to gather fresh background, announcements, and unstructured web context.
Use Context7 to confirm official API, configuration, and version-specific guidance.
Use UI UX Pro Max to improve interaction quality, visual hierarchy, and responsive polish.
combos.prompt: I am working on a coding task. Please use Firecrawl for fresh research, Context7 for official documentation, and UI UX Pro Max to refine the frontend experience.
